summary: Short steep east kerb at a junction with a No Stopping sign.
reasons: No Stopping Any Time sign on kerb

drivers.seclusion: Homes about 20 m away on the opposite side; units opposite the junction; bush to the north.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street narrowing at a bend; east kerb is kerb-to-garden with no pull-off, and a sign bans stopping.
drivers.convention: Cars park on the west side only; the east kerb has a No Stopping Any Time sign 0.8 m from it.

flags: No Stopping Any Time sign at the kerb
Junction mouth, no room off the lane
sun_shade: Heavy tree shade from the north and east; open to afternoon sun from the west.

best_section.where: East kerb of Manchester Terrace at the junction mouth, beside the shrub garden
